items.title: Use of Machine Learning in Healthcare (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Use of Machine Learning in Healthcare' under topic 6.5 (PDF 80-81, printed 76-77).

blocks.text: Healthcare mein machine learning medical data parakhti hai aur bimari ki detection (pehchan) aur diagnosis (tashkhees, bimari ka pata lagana) mein madad deti hai. Misal ke taur par yeh medical images mein cancer ke cells dhoondne, Alzheimer ya dementia (yaaddasht ki bimari) ki shuru ki nishaniyan pehchanne, aur cardiovascular (dil aur khoon ki nalion ki) bimariyon ki tashkhees mein madad kar sakti hai. Doctor in results se behtar aur waqt par ilaj ka mansooba bana sakte hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Ek saada dataset lein, jaise talaba ke marks aur grades. Talaba khud tay karein ke kaun sa data training ke liye aur kaun sa testing ke liye istemal ho sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Beech mein daira jis mein dimagh (brain) aur MACHINE LEARNING likha hai; is se chaar teer chaar konon tak: Healthcare (Medical Diagnosis, Predictive Analytics, Drug Discovery), Business (Customer Insights, Fraud Detection, Sales Forecasting), Education (Adaptive Learning, Student Assessment, Tutoring Systems) aur Daily Life (Virtual Assistants, Recommendation, Smart Home), har aik ke saath tasveer.

blocks.long_description: Tasveerein: tibbi chart, stethoscope aur phephron ka scan (Healthcare); briefcase, bar chart, oopar jata teer aur dollar wala magnifier (Business); kitabein, graduation topi aur AI wala laptop (Education); smart speaker baat ke bulbule ke saath aur Wi-Fi wala ghar (Daily Life).
